Community Beer Co. Cycling Group Ride

Dallas, TX · Design District / Medical District · Road · Social

Community Beer Co. Cycling Group Ride is a road and social group ride in Dallas, TX. It rolls every other Saturday and Sunday at 9:00 am from Community Beer Company. Pace: multiple groups and paces, all levels.

Next ride Sat, Oct 3, 9:00 AM CDT every other week — confirm which week with the host

For visitors

Free RSVP on Prekindle (linked from the Meetup event). Helmet, nutrition and water; water is available at the brewery. The host says some rides are Saturday and some Sunday, and the time sometimes shifts, so check each event.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: multiple groups and paces, all levels. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @communitybeerco the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Community Beer Co. Cycling Group Ride group ride

A free group ride from Community Beer Company, every other week. Several groups for different riders, a short ride talk first, and cold beer back at the taproom. The host alternates Saturday and Sunday and the start can move, so check each event.
